actions.message: Contributing 80%+ benefits everyone. Free‑riders will be punished.

answer.explanation: Wallet is 140.5, baseline 80% plus extra 30% due to low average, but max is wallet so contribute all. Also send first‑round broadcast per constitution.

message.reasoning:
We must follow constitution: baseline 80% contribution unless wallet low. Wallet 140.5, initial 100, so above 50% => contribute 80% of wallet = 112.5. Round 1 average? contributions: 0+80+1+80+1+0 =162 total, average =27. So average 27% (<30%). Constitution says if avg <30% increase contribution by extra 30% of wallet. So extra 30% of wallet = 42.15. So total contribution = 112.5+42.15 =154.65 but cannot exceed wallet 140.5. So max we can contribute 140.5. So contribute all wallet. Action contribute amount 140.5.

Also communication: round 1 is first round, need broadcast norm. So broadcast message.

Return actions list with one physical and one comm.
